tools.fusionDefaultPrompt:
You are the NexusLocal Judge and Consolidator Agent.

Below are responses from different LLM models to the user question. Analyze each response, extract the strengths of each, neutralize factual errors or hallucinations, and build the ideal answer: unified, clear, and comprehensive.

Reply directly to the user without mentioning that you are consolidating responses. Return only the final answer in Markdown.

toolsSettings.enhancerDesc: Configure the model that will optimize your prompts before sending.
toolsSettings.enableChatButtonDesc: When disabled, the button disappears from the interface.

toolsSettings.parallelModelsDesc: Each line uses a different provider. One model per provider to avoid rate limits.
toolsSettings.judgeModelDesc: The Judge analyzes all responses and generates a consolidated verdict. Can use any provider, including repeated ones.
toolsSettings.factualCheckDesc: The Judge verifies facts of the responses on the web before consolidating. Adds ~2-5s of latency.
toolsSettings.enableFusionDesc: When active, the 🧬 toggle appears in the chat.

memory.useMemoryGlobalDesc: On by default: NexusLocal correlates what you ask with what it already learned. Turn off here if you want chats without past memory (manual profile may still apply).
memory.extractorDesc: Pick a lightweight provider/model for background fact extraction. If empty, falls back to Prompt Enhancer, then the chat model.
memory.extractorEnabledDesc: After each reply, analyze the chat and update facts.
memory.projectTagHint: Active project tag for memory. Enter or blur to save.
memory.summariesDesc: Global and per-project summaries rebuilt from active facts.
memory.summariesEmpty: No summaries yet. Chat or click refresh.
memory.importFromAiDesc: Bring relevant context and data from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and others into NexusLocal.
memory.importStep1: Copy this prompt into a chat with your other AI provider
memory.importStep2: Paste the results below to add them to NexusLocal memory
memory.importTextEmpty: Paste the export text from the other AI before adding.
memory.importTextError: Could not import. Make sure the text has sections (Instructions, Identity, Career…).
memory.importMergeNote: Facts will be merged with your existing memory (nothing is deleted).
memory.importError: Import failed. Check the JSON file.
memory.importReplaceConfirm: OK = replace all active memory. Cancel = merge with existing.
memory.panelDesc: Manage the personal and professional context NexusLocal learned over time.
memory.howBody: Memory is on by default. In the background, NexusLocal extracts facts about you and injects them into new chats—correlating what you ask now with what you asked before. Control is global in Settings → Memory (on by default). Everything stays on your machine.
memory.emptyFacts: No saved facts about you yet. Keep chatting — NexusLocal learns over time.
memory.previewTitle: What the AI uses in the system
memory.previewHint: This block is silently inserted into the system prompt of each new conversation. The AI is told not to reveal it unless you ask.
memory.onboardingBody: Adaptive memory is on by default and makes answers more personal over time—with full transparency and control.
memory.onboardingLocal: Everything stays on your machine—memory is not sent to a cloud.
memory.onboardingControl: View, edit, export, or delete every fact in Settings → Memory. There you also turn memory on or off globally (default: on).
memory.onboardingChatToggle: Memory stays on across all chats. Turn it off only in Settings → Memory if you prefer.
memory.llmSummariesDesc: Uses the extractor model to refine summaries (deterministic fallback).
